steps.instruction: Rename the Todo field `done: boolean` to `completed: boolean`. No other change. Update any of your own tests that build Todo objects to use `completed` (if an existing test must change, request it).

Todo's `done` field is renamed to `completed` (Todo is now { id: number; title: string; completed: boolean; due?: string }). Replace every read of `todo.done` with `todo.completed`. Rendered output must stay exactly the same as before. Update test fixtures accordingly.

Todo's `done` field is renamed to `completed` (Todo is now { id: number; title: string; completed: boolean; due?: string }). save must write `completed` (never `done`). For backward compatibility, load must convert legacy records that have `done` but no `completed` into `completed: <done value>` and must not keep a `done` property on returned objects. Update test fixtures accordingly.

Todo's `done` field is renamed to `completed` (Todo is now { id: number; title: string; completed: boolean; due?: string }). add must create todos with `completed: false`; complete must set `completed: true`; list filtering must use `completed`. Keep ListOptions.includeDone as-is (name unchanged, it now filters on `completed`). No other behaviour changes. Update test fixtures accordingly.

input.reason: This field rename touches the shared Todo type, so every unit has to change together to keep tsc passing.
